newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LOGAN SCORES TWICE IN SCOTLAND VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LOGAN SCORES TWICE IN SCOTLAND VICTORY.

text.p: Kenny Logan scored two second half tries on Saturday to help Scotland overcome a four-point halftime deficit and defeat Italy 29-22.
Logan scored once from the left wing then added a second after switching to full-back when Rowen Shepherd was forced to leave the field early in the second half.
Scotland's other tries came from right wing Tony Stanger and replacement Derek Stark, who took over from Logan on the left wing.
The accurate boot of fly-half Diego Doiminguez kept Italy in the hunt throughout the match.
He gave Italy a 12-8 halftime lead with drop goal and three penalties and added a further five points in the second half. Italy's only other points came from a penalty try.
Scotland went into the lead for the first time two minutes after the interval thanks to clever work by Scott Hastings and Gregor Townsend in the centres.

The pair pulled the Italian defence out of position and then the ball was moved late the Scots were left with a two-man overlap. Locks Damian Cronin and Andy Reed carried the movement on and Logan was left with a clear run to the posts.
With Shepherd now off the field, Craig Chalmers took over the goal kicking and converted Logan's try to make it 15-12.
A further Logan try extended Scotland's lead to 22-12 but Italy were not finished, drawing level with the penalty try and a further Dominguez penalty.

Scotland finally secured victory 11 minutes from time when Hastings broke up a threatening Italian attack and Chalmers was first to the ball. Scrum-half Bryan Redpath was quick in support and sent Stark away for a thrilling try which Chalmers converted.

Scotland - 15-Rowen Shepherd (Peter Stark); 14-Tony Stanger, 13-Scott Hastings, 12-Gregor Townsend (captain), 11-Kenny Logan; 10-Craig Chalmers, 9-Bryan Redpath; 8-Eric Peters, 7-Ian Smith, 6-Murray Wallace, 5-Andy Reed, 4-Damian Cronin, 3-Mattie Stewart, 2-Kevin McKenzie, 1-David Hilton.

Italy - 15-Javier Pertile; 14-Nicola Mazzucato, 13-Paolo Vaccari, 12-Ivan Francescato, 11-Marcello Cuttitta; 10-Diego Dominguez, 9-Alessandro Troncon; 8-Orazio Arancio, 7-Andrea Sgorlon, 6-Massimo Giovanelli (captain), 5-Giambattista Croci, 4-Walter Cristofoletto, 3-Andrea Castellani, 2-Carlo Orlandi, 1-Massimo Cuttitta.
